mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates ultra-accommodative monetary policy, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals economic weakness that depresses corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) and low housing starts (HOUST < 1000) indicate a contracting housing sector and labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both UNRATE > 6.0% and HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime, a 1% monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals accelerating manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings forecasts and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises > 1% in a 1-month window during the post-recession recovery regime.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1000 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand for housing, stimulating construction and related sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1000.

mechanism_narrative: In the high labor participation regime, a monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% signals sustained economic expansion, driving positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in a 1-month window during high labor participation.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% indicates emergency monetary policy, triggering immediate positive equity market reactions within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 235 indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.
